What needs attention error_outline Missing local inventory data Limits visibility in United States expand_less You're missing inventory data for products in your physical stores. If you don't have a physical store, remove Free local listings and Local inventory ads add-ons from your Merchant Center account Make sure you meet the following requirements You must complete the setup of free local listings and/or local inventory ads including the Add inventory step from the Adds-on page Your local inventory data must include required attributes such as [store_code] , [item_id] , [quantity] , and/or [availability] If you've added free local listings and local inventory ads as marketing methods, they are turned on for all your products but all the products may not be available in your physical stores. To exclude certain products from showing in free local listings or local inventory ads, you can use the [excluded_destination] attribute in your data source to indicate the marketing methods to turn off free_local_listings and local_inventory_ads How to fix: Missing local inventory datalaunch Other products may have the same issue.
